name: Assassin Camp
source:
A story about royalty, escape, assassinations, friendship, family, and trust.

You play as Dema, a young runaway would-be monarch, as she and her younger sibling flee an assassination attempt on them and their father's lives. A knight swears to keep you safe. A farm boy keeps you company. Your sibling misses home. You try to be a better person.
